newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-ZIDANE IN CONFIDENT MOOD FOR JUVENTUS TIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ZIDANE IN CONFIDENT MOOD FOR JUVENTUS TIE.

text.p: Juventus's French international midfielder Zinedine Zidane gives Norwegian part-timers Rosenborg little or no chance of upsetting the odds in their European Cup quarter-final meeting on Wednesday.
"Rosenborg shouldn't be too big a problem," he said on the eve of the first leg.
With all due respect, if we play to our best then we'll prove the better side and go through.
"At the moment, I think Juventus are the best team in Italy...and perhaps also in Europe".
Few would argue as the serie A leaders approach the match in Trondheim in buoyant mood, seven points clear of Internazionale and Parma.
Zidane, who missed Juve's 2-0 league win over Vicenza on Saturday, returns to the side along with compatriot Didier Deschamps to replace Alessio Tacchinardi and Atillio Lombardo.

The availability of the French midfielders partly compensates Juventus for the injury-enforced absence of first-choice strikers Alessandro Del Piero and Croat Alen Boksic. They will be replaced by Michele Padovano and Christian Vieri.
Juventus are strengthened at the back by the return of first-choice goalkeeper Angelo Peruzzi who missed the club's last two league games.

Rosenborg, who stunned five-times European champions AC Milan by qualifying for the last eight at their expense, prepared for the tie in Cyprus where they won two matches and drew one in an unofficial cup competition.

They have no injury or suspension problems but several players -- Jon Olav Hjelde, Roar Strand, Bent Skammelsrud, Harald Brattbakk, Bjoern Otto Bragstad and Trond Egil Soltvedt -- have yellow cards hanging over them.
The match will draw a capacity crowd of 20,800 to the Lerkendal stadium in Norway's second oldest city.

Juventus - (probable) Angelo Peruzzi; Moreno Torricelli, Paolo Montero, Ciro Ferrara, Gianluca Pessotto; Angelo Di Livio, Zinedine Zidane, Didier Deschamps, Vladimir Jugovic; Michele Padovano, Christian Vieri.
